primary_outcome: combined 11-unit mortality damages by NC receptor county
valuation_warning: 2026 conversion uses Jan-Oct 2026 CPI-U average (latest available at preparation), not final calendar-year 2026 CPI. Base AP4 value is labeled 2020 USD in MATLAB output.
model_warning: AP4 chemistry is nonlinear; standalone sites and NOx/SO2 scenarios cannot be summed to reproduce combined damages. Historical 2017 AP4 exposures/population/mortality plus 2024 emissions benchmarks. Davie uses a county non-EGU point-source proxy; five other sites use historical EGU source-row approximations. No updated 2024 population or facility-specific stack geometry is modeled.
geography_warning: Receptors are limited to NC; damages outside NC excluded.
regression_guidance: Join by receptor_fips as a 5-character string. Use combined damages as primary dependent variable. Do not add standalone site columns.
